status: Provisional assistant policy-fit review of three examples; no alignment estimate or production rule

definitions.directly_comparable: Question addresses a named policy/disposition component of the decision; not necessarily the entire opinion or legal rationale.
definitions.broadly_contextual: Related attitude but no defensible mapping from response categories to the specific holding. Not eligible for direct alignment scoring.
definitions.unsuitable: Wrong construct or timing even for the specified contextual comparison.

primary_pairs.case_name: ROE et al. v. WADE, DISTRICT ATTORNEY OF DALLAS COUNTY

primary_pairs.wording_note: Legal in all cases = +1; legal in some cases = 0; illegal in all cases = −1. The midpoint represents conditional legality, not necessarily ideological centrism. Unknown, skipped and not-asked answers are excluded. Wave-specific cross-sectional weights are used.

supplemental.question: As you may know, the 1973 Supreme Court Case Roe v. Wade established a woman's constitutional right to have an abortion. Would you like to see the Supreme Court overturn its Roe v. Wade decision, or not?
supplemental.evidence_note: Stored 2020Nov wave provenance references VOTER guide page 40. Not newly verified against raw respondents in this review.
limitations: Does not measure opinions on Mississippi’s fifteen-week restriction, all resulting state laws, or constitutional reasoning.
Unknown answers must remain distinct from support/opposition; examine full response shares rather than only the valid-answer signed mean.
National November 2020 attitudes are not June 2022 attitudes; no causal or forecasting claim.
This is a proposed separate component comparison, not added to primary coverage or chosen from its score.

decision: Do not compute case-specific agreement from the ten general-question pairs. A descriptive contextual comparison is possible; a narrower component-specific comparison is more promising than extending an exact-policy claim to all 17 cases.
limitations: Three diagnostic cases, not a representative audit of all 17.
Stored CES/GSS wording is summarized; exact year-specific questionnaires remain to verify before quantitative analysis.
Primary categories are judgments about measurement compatibility, not independent legal adjudication.
No survey means were used to select policy-fit labels.
